headline: No race has been called yet. The first polls closed at 23:00 UTC in parts of Indiana and Kentucky.
headlineIs: Úrslit eru hvergi ljós enn. Fyrstu kjörstaðir lokuðu kl. 23:00 að íslenskum tíma í hlutum Indiana og Kentucky.
conventions: senate = seats not up (D 32, R 31, I 2) plus called races, i.e. seats in the new chamber. house and governors = called races only.
